newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat firms on busy ports.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat firms on busy ports.

text.p: Argentine cash wheat firmed in moderate cash market trade at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with bids squeezed up by tight supply and congested ports, traders said.

Prices paid to farmers in Bahia Blanca rose $3 to $135. April maize was steady at $100 in moderate turnover, with the climate behaving well and little of novelty disturbing the market. May soybeans firmed $2 to $252 in similar volume, with prices supported by a firmer CBOT and dry Brazilian weather. March sunflower seed was unmoved at $206 in slow trade.
